code='''def transform(grid):
    # Each rectangle is a tile separated by full lines of the divider color.
    sep = 9 if all(v == 9 for v in grid[0]) else None
    # In this task the separator color is the value filling complete rows and columns.
    rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    cols = [j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1]
    rb = [-1] + rows + [len(grid)]
    cb = [-1] + cols + [len(grid[0])]
    out = []
    for a, b in zip(rb, rb[1:]):
        line = []
        for x, y in zip(cb, cb[1:]):
            vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(a+1,b) for c in range(x+1,y)]
            from collections import Counter
            counts = Counter(vals)
            base = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
            # A pair of isolated marks is encoded as 1; otherwise retain the panel background.
            mark = next((color for color, n in counts.items() if color != base and n == 2), None)
            line.append(1 if mark is not None else base)
        out.append(line)
    return out
